stories.title: Mike Ditka dies at 86
stories.summary: Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end who coached the 1985 Bears to a Super Bowl win, died at 86. Adam Schefter's post got 82K likes, the NFL's 48K and Barack Obama's tribute 46K, and old clips of his sideline rants and the "Da Bears" sketches resurfaced. The same day, the Nobel Peace Prize went to Navi Pillay and Hurricane Isaias hit the Florida Panhandle as a Category 3.
